name: xquik-post-monitor-template
description: Track X posts with Xquik, an X Twitter data API, using Cron Triggers & D1.

XQUIK_API_KEY.description: Your Xquik API key. Sign in at [xquik.com](https://xquik.com) & create a key in the dashboard. Without a key, the template runs in demo mode with sample posts.

XQUIK_SEARCH_QUERY.description: The search term to track. It accepts [X search operators](https://github.com/Xquik-dev/x-twitter-advanced-search).

XQUIK_SEARCH_LIMIT.description: The most posts to fetch per scheduled run. Lower it to spend fewer credits.

scripts.deploy: wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev --test-scheduled
